pageCache.text:
Welcome to Maiden Beech Primary Academy
At Maiden Beech Primary Academy, we are curious, kind and confident. These values drive all that we do. Maiden Beech serves the town of Crewkerne and the surrounding communities. We see ourselves at the heart of the community where children really matter. We want them to feel happy, valued and secure and will provide them with an excellent education.
As we are currently developing our new website, if there is information you would like but cannot find here, please do contact the school by emailing office@maidenbeechprimary.org or calling us on 01460 72677.
Book your tour now and apply to join our Reception class in September 2026!

pageCache.pageTitle: Maiden Beech Primary Academy - About Us
pageCache.text:
About Us
Maiden Beech Primary Academy is an exciting and forward thinking school committed to providing the highest standard of education for every learner. We see ourselves at the heart of the community where children really matter and every individual’s ability is recognised, developed and rewarded.
We believe in providing an environment and curriculum which stimulates every child’s desire to learn and enables them to achieve their potential. Through our creative approach, we aim to provide a primary experience that will always be remembered.
At Maiden Beech Primary Academy, we are curious, kind and confident.
If you would like to arrange a school tour, call us on 01460 72677 or email office@maidenbeechprimary.org

pageCache.pageTitle: Maiden Beech Primary Academy - Extra Curricular Clubs and Opportunities
pageCache.text:
Extra Curricular Clubs and Opportunities
We have a range of clubs and opportunities at Maiden Beech that enrich our learners time at school. Our list of clubs grows throughout the year and can be signed up for via our Arbor App.
If you are an interested in supporting our school's wide and varied clubs by sharing a specialism (e.g. singing, sports, arts, languages ), then please get in touch with the school office to discuss options of working together.

pageCache.pageTitle: Maiden Beech Primary Academy - Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Wraparound Care
At Maiden Beech Primary Academy, we are committed to providing a wraparound care offer at MBPA to support our whole school community. We will continue to monitor and assess the provision we provide in relation to demand.
We offer wraparound care Monday to Friday during term-time times before and after school. Sessions will need to be pre-booked a week in advance to ensure suitable and safe supervision can be provided. This can be done via the school office:
office@maidenbeechprimary.org
Morning sessions will will be charged as a ‘flat fee’ of £5.
Morning sessions run from 07.30 - 08.45.
Afternoon sessions will need to be booked as a minimum of one hour, and in 30 minute increments beyond that.
Afternoon sessions will be charged at £4 per hour and £2 per half hour.
Afternoon sessions run from 15.15 - 17.15
If your child/ren attend wraparound care before 08.00 or after 16.15, then they will be offered a healthy snack free of charge (e.g. toast, fruit).
If you are interested in using the wraparound care provision, please contact the school office to discuss your personal requirements.

The PE and Sports Premium is government funding to enable additional and sustainable improvements to the provision of PE and Sport in primary schools and encourage the development of health and active lifestyles. This funding is ring fenced and can only be used for this purpose.
Primary schools are required to report annually on the amount of funding received and how this funding was allocated.

pageCache.pageTitle: Maiden Beech Primary Academy - For Parents
pageCache.text:
For Parents
We strongly believe in the partnership between ourselves, families and the community. We welcome connections to the wider community and value our relationships within the local area.
Transition
Our on site pre school facility aims to enable children to experience a seamless transition into school and prepares them for school life.
Before your child begins at Maiden Beech Primary Academy, they will have the opportunity to be visited in their current childcare setting. They will be invited onto the school site to explore their surroundings and meet their new teachers and peers. When they begin at Maiden Beech Primary Academy, a staggered start timetable will allow your child to settle with ease in a positive manner. A home visit will also take place to allow each child to share their home identity with school and to provide time for an informal meeting with families.
Permissions
We are conscious of our environment and are taking steps to become more sustainable. One way we hope to do this is by reducing our use of paper. We are instead using electronic means of communicating for our newsletter, about trips and visits, and for permission and consent forms. Below are the current permission and consent forms in use that you may need to complete. If you have any questions, then please do not hesitate to contact the school office.

pageCache.pageTitle: Maiden Beech Primary Academy - Reading - Phonics
pageCache.text:
Reading - Phonics
We use a validated systematic synthetic phonics (SSP) scheme called Sounds Write to support our teaching and learning of phonics. Its purpose is to provide classroom professionals with a comprehensive system with which to teach reading, spelling and writing. It is introduced in Reception (YR), taught in KS1 and fine-tuned throughout the rest of Key Stage 2. In Year 1, all children undergo the statutory phonics screening check.
For further information on Sounds Write, please take a look at the leaflet below or watch their introductory video.
Sounds Write Information Leaflet YR
https://www.sounds-write.co.uk/sites/soundswrite/uploads/files/54-sw_video_sync.mp4
Sounds Write have developed their own app available for use on iPads. This app offers a variety of activities to develop the skills of blending and segmenting, sound spelling correspondence, word reading and writing and some sentences reading and writing.The app introduces all the sound-spelling correspondences your child needs to learn to put them well on the way to learning to read and write.
Sounds Write App on iTunes
Here is a video modelling how we make pure sounds when teaching phonics:
//www.youtube.com/embed/UCI2mu7URBc#t=0.5
For more information on the statutory phonics screening check, please look at our factsheet.
Phonics Screening Factsheet
We know that modelling reading at home will strongly support your child's learning and development. We have 'Reading at Home' workshops running throughout the year to provide opportunities to learn together about how best to help your child to read. We also host 'Cosy Book Cafes' to encourage reading for pleasure as a school community.
